text.en: Siemens industrial visual specs, 3D device standards, 2.5D modular equipment, Copilot IP—consistency across complex systems.

subtitle.zh: 我想用这个沙漏结构表达——以 AI 工具实践与探索的多元输入；腰部以经验与沉淀充当门控，压缩噪声、提炼判断；下方将知识释放为业务场景的落地应用与快速迭代，并持续回流。
subtitle.en: I use this hourglass to express my path—diverse input from AI tool practice and exploration; a waist of experience and accumulated judgment that filters noise and refines decisions; below, knowledge released into real business scenarios, rapid iteration, and continuous feedback upstream.

sidebarSummary.zh: 产品经理与产品设计师，聚焦医疗、工业 B 端与实验室自动化。UAL 创意计算机硕士。从 SiePA 大屏到医疗 MVP、化合物数据管道——复杂系统，清晰可交付。
sidebarSummary.en: Product manager and designer across healthcare, industrial B2B, and lab automation. MA Creative Computing at UAL. From SiePA dashboards to medical MVPs and compound data pipelines—complex systems made clear and shippable.

bio.zh: 不想被 PM、UX、UI、工业设计等标签框住。我更关注基于数据管道的建模与场景应用——在 AI 时代快速迭代，把经验沉淀为可复用的能力，并持续推进到可交付、可落地的结果。通过设计与创新，去解决或平衡复杂场景——在多重约束与诉求之间，寻找到可推进的路径与目标。
bio.en: I don't want to be boxed in by PM, UX, UI, or industrial design labels. I'm more focused on data-pipeline modeling and scenario application—iterating quickly in the AI era, turning experience into reusable capabilities, and pushing work through to deliverable, production-ready outcomes. Through design and innovation, I address or balance complex scenarios—finding actionable paths and goals amid multiple constraints and competing needs.

subtitle.en: Interactive prototypes and technical demos to validate ideas

summary.zh: 化合物条件筛选与手套箱操控界面，串联从 Agent 下发实验设计到自动化实验全流程。
summary.en: Compound condition screening and glove box control UI—from Agent-driven experiment design through automated experiment execution.

description.zh: 化合物条件筛选。Agent 基于分子知识库筛选推荐 + 自主实验设计工具 + 图形化手套箱与机械臂操控界面，串联实验全流程并与自动化设备联动，支持礼来制药完成千万级项目工厂验收。
description.en: Compound condition screening. Agent-driven screening and recommendations from a molecular knowledge base, plus autonomous experiment design tools and graphical glove box & robotic arm control UI—connecting the full experimental workflow with lab automation, supporting Eli Lilly factory acceptance on a ~$10M program.

role.zh: 软件产品经理 · 交互设计负责人

team.zh: 控制 · 调度 · 机械 · 前端工程师

problem.zh: 自主实验室场景下，化合物筛选涉及 Agent 推荐、实验设计、手套箱操控与自动化设备联动——多方约束叠加，需要在合规与安全边界内，让一线人员快速理解并执行复杂流程。
problem.en: In autonomous lab compound screening, Agent recommendations, experiment design, glove box control, and automation must work together—many constraints at once, with operators needing to understand and execute complex flows safely and compliantly.

approach.zh: 以「推荐—设计—执行—分析—优化—报告」全流程为主线，用 step 引导与 2.5D 图形化降低认知负荷；建立资源树与状态机规范，把物理设备与软件逻辑对齐，并在安全、维护、耗材等模块划定清晰边界。
approach.en: Structured the full loop—recommend → design → execute → analyze → optimize → report—with step guidance and 2.5D graphics to reduce cognitive load; aligned physical devices to software via resource trees and state-machine specs, with clear boundaries for safety, maintenance, and consumables.

impact.zh: 支撑礼来制药千万级项目工厂验收
impact.en: Supported Eli Lilly factory acceptance on a ~$10M program

impact.zh: 串联 Agent 实验设计到手套箱自动化执行的完整闭环
impact.en: Closed the loop from Agent experiment design to glove box automation

impact.zh: 沉淀 2.5D 图形引擎、资源树与状态机等可复用模块
impact.en: Distilled reusable 2.5D engine, resource tree, and state-machine modules

text.zh: 串联「推荐—设计—执行—分析—多轮优化—报告」全流程，与手套箱自动化联动，形成自主实验室闭环。
text.en: Connected recommend → design → execute → analyze → multi-round optimization → report, integrated with glove box automation for an autonomous lab closed loop.

text.zh: 复杂场景下通过 step 步骤引导用户执行，创建 AI 生成辅助 GIF 插图引导用户打包出料等人工操作。
text.en: In complex scenarios, guide users through step-by-step flows—AI-generated GIF illustrations support manual operations such as packaging and material discharge.

text.zh: 设计并优化实验设计 Agent 会话与谱图生成，提升实验方案迭代效率。
text.en: Designed and optimized experiment-design Agent conversations and spectrum generation to speed up protocol iteration.

title.zh: 2.5D 图形化 · SVG 引擎与资源树

text.zh: 基于 SVG 引擎设计 2.5D 图形化各设备模块，与资源树绑定——支持模块资源详情查看，统一点位 / 槽位 / 托盘 / 试管状态与类型展示，并定义状态机等核心组件样式规范。
text.en: Built 2.5D graphical device modules on an SVG engine, bound to the resource tree—module-level resource inspection with unified point, slot, tray, and tube status/type views, plus state-machine and core component style definitions.

text.zh: 建立配色系统；设计出入库流程弹窗与分步引导，划定安全边界——覆盖急停恢复等异常处理、维护模式管理，以及损耗部件统计与更换倒计时。
text.en: Defined a color system plus inbound/outbound modals with step-by-step guidance; set safety boundaries—e-stop recovery and exception flows, maintenance mode management, and wear-part tracking with replacement countdowns.

text.zh: 垃圾桶、Tip 头、稀释剂等耗材与设备状态实时监测；接入内仓摄像头画面，以百分比等方式呈现余量，帮助一线人员快速掌握设备健康度。
text.en: Real-time monitoring for consumables (waste bin, tip heads, diluent) and device health—internal camera feeds and percentage-level displays so operators grasp equipment status at a glance.

title.zh: 跨职能协同 · 初代落地

text.zh: 深度配合控制、调度、机械与前端工程师，参与初代软硬件产品规划与设计，从概念到可部署方案一并推进，最终实现工厂落地。
text.en: Partnered closely with controls, scheduling, mechanical, and frontend engineers on v1 hardware–software planning and design—from concept through deployable specs to on-site factory rollout.

summary.zh: 负责加粉、加液实验设计与图形化软件操控台面设计，并组织设计评审和开发上线支持。
summary.en: Owned powder and liquid dispensing experiment design and graphical software control UI—and led design reviews plus development launch support.

description.zh: Neo Dispenser 作为标准品上市：解决药企毫克级粉末分装问题。作为主要软件产品经理，负责加粉、加液实验设计与操控界面。串联「上料入库 → 实验设计 → 预览分析 → 任务执行 → 结果出库」全流程，以表现层、实验设计、校验、执行结果回流四层架构，支持用户 CSV 自定义配置与 Mapview 图形化操控：快捷实验设计，覆盖 PlateMap 资源映射（对应托盘孔板和试管）、资源充足性校验到实时运行监控与结果回传。
description.en: Neo Dispenser launched as a standard product—addressing milligram-scale powder dispensing for pharma labs. As lead software product manager, I owned powder and liquid dispensing experiment design and control UI. End-to-end flow from loading → design → preview → execution → results, built on four layers—presentation, experiment design, validation, and result feedback—supporting user-defined CSV setup and Mapview graphical control for rapid experiment design, PlateMap resource mapping (tray wells and tubes), resource sufficiency checks, live runtime monitoring, and result export.

text.zh: 面向药企毫克级粉末分装场景，覆盖加粉与加液双模式，打通上料入库到结果出库的完整实验链路，将复杂投料流程产品化为可复用标准能力。
text.en: Built for pharma milligram powder dispensing—powder and liquid modes in one product, with a full pipeline from loading to results that turns complex dosing into a reusable, shippable capability.

text.zh: CSV 支持批量自定义与灵活复用，Mapview 图形化台面降低上手门槛；两种路径兼顾效率与直观性，让实验员能更快完成方案配置与迭代。
text.en: CSV for batch custom setup and reuse; Mapview graphical UI for intuitive, low-friction design—two paths that balance speed and clarity so operators configure and iterate experiments faster.

text.zh: 将托盘孔位、试管与加样任务一一对应，支持 1 对 1 / 1 对 N 映射与多实验组管理；物理资源与软件逻辑对齐，减少错配与返工。
text.en: Aligns tray wells, tubes, and dosing tasks with 1:1 and 1:N mapping plus multi-group runs—physical resources matched to software logic to cut mis-mapping and rework.

text.zh: 执行前完成资源充足性与规则校验，避免无效上机；运行中 Mapview 实时反馈进度与耗材状态，结束后 Result CSV 回传转移量、损耗与时间戳，全程可审计。
text.en: Pre-run sufficiency and rule checks prevent wasted runs; live Mapview tracks progress and consumables during execution; Result CSV exports amounts, loss, and timestamps for end-to-end traceability.

summary.zh: 面向实验室的中央物料路由概念系统，探索高密存储与自动化流转。（保密项目，内容有限展示）
summary.en: A central material routing concept for labs—exploring high-density storage and automated flow. (Confidential—limited public detail.)

description.zh: 晶泰科技实验室自动化方向的概念项目。负责产品概念与展示层面的信息梳理，更多细节因保密暂不便公开。
description.en: A concept project in XtalPi lab automation. I contributed to product concept and presentation structure; further details remain confidential.

summary.zh: 面向自动化实验室的数字引擎——通过 Agent 编排任务输入输出，并以 CLI 自动化执行命令与脚本，集中管理实验下发、调度与管控。
summary.en: A digital engine for automated labs—Agent orchestrates task I/O while CLI automates command and script execution, centrally managing experiment dispatch, scheduling, and control.

description.zh: 面向自动化实验室的数字引擎系统。通过工站数据管道接口统一接入各工站，以 Agent 驱动实验任务的输入输出与流程编排；底层依托 CLI 自动化执行命令与脚本，完成调度、管控与结果回传。构成从任务定义到执行闭环的整体数字底座。
description.en: A digital engine for automated labs. Workstation data-pipeline interfaces unify access across stations; Agents drive task I/O and workflow orchestration, while CLI automation executes commands and scripts for scheduling, control, and result feedback—forming the end-to-end digital foundation from task definition to execution.

summary.zh: 西门子医疗 DR 长骨拼接架早期预研，主导方案定义、PRD 与临床工作流设计。
summary.en: Siemens Healthineers DR long-leg collimation research—solution definition, PRD, and clinical workflow.

description.zh: 西门子医疗 · DR 长骨拼接架早期预研。2022.12—2023.6 作为主要产品设计师，定义方案、撰写 PRD，支撑多轮迭代与供应商汇报；聚焦长骨自动运输与拼接流程的临床工作流与可交付细节。
description.en: Siemens Healthineers · DR long-leg collimation early research. Dec 2022—Jun 2023 as lead product designer—solution definition, PRD, multi-round iteration and vendor reviews; clinical workflow and delivery details for automated long-bone transport and stitching.

text.zh: 2022.12—2023.6 作为早期预研项目的主要产品设计师，从方案定义到 PRD 支撑多轮迭代。
text.en: Dec 2022—Jun 2023: lead product designer on early-stage research—from solution definition and PRD through multi-round iteration.

text.zh: 采用麦克纳姆轮与巡线避障模块，实现在狭小空间内对重型医疗设备的精准自主移动。
text.en: Mecanum wheels plus line-following and obstacle avoidance enable precise autonomous movement of heavy medical equipment in confined clinical spaces.

description.zh: 院内临床路径交互装置，问卷调研 + 场景原型，陈列于上海西门子创新中心。2023.3—2023.6 作为独立设计师完成设计、制作与发布。
description.en: In-hospital clinical pathway interactive installation—research and scenario prototypes, showcased at Siemens Healthineers Shanghai Innovation Center. Mar—Jun 2023, delivered end-to-end as an independent designer.

text.zh: 2023.3—2023.6 作为独立设计师，以约 2,000 元预算独立完成设计、制作与发布全流程。
text.en: Mar—Jun 2023: as an independent designer, delivered design, fabrication, and launch end-to-end on a ~¥2,000 budget.

text.zh: 项目成果向西门子医疗 CEO / CFO 汇报展示。
text.en: Presented project outcomes to Siemens Healthineers CEO and CFO.

summary.zh: 工业 AI 预测性维护系统与 3D 泵组视觉标准——多维数据分析、大屏交付与设备资产可视化一体建设。
summary.en: Industrial AI predictive maintenance plus 3D pump-skid visual standards—analytics, dashboard delivery, and equipment visualization in one program.

description.zh: Siemens Predictive Analytics（SiePA）是一款工业 AI 智能预测性维护系统，基于生产过程数据（如温度、压力、流量等）进行多维度关联分析，实时评估运行状态，实现从被动维修到预测性维护的监控升级。负责工业 AI 大屏视觉规范、组件体系与高保真交付，支撑预测模型结果的可读呈现与运维决策。同步建立 3D 泵组 Keyshot 统一渲染与 360° 交互序列，制定 SiePA 设备类型模板与工程图视觉规范，保障监控界面与设备资产的一致呈现。
description.en: Siemens Predictive Analytics (SiePA) is an industrial AI predictive maintenance system—multi-dimensional correlation analysis on process data (temperature, pressure, flow, and more) with real-time operational assessment, upgrading monitoring from reactive repair to predictive maintenance. Owned industrial AI dashboard visual standards, component system, and hi-fi delivery so model outputs read clearly and support ops decisions. In parallel, built Keyshot-unified 3D pump-skid renders and 360° interaction sequences, plus SiePA equipment-type templates and engineering drawing standards—keeping monitoring UI and equipment assets visually consistent.

role.zh: 用户体验设计实习生 · 大屏与 3D 视觉负责人
role.en: UX Design Intern · Dashboard & 3D visual lead

team.zh: 工业 AI 产品 · 前端 · 3D 设计协作
team.en: Industrial AI product · Frontend · 3D design collaboration

problem.zh: 工业预测性维护系统需要将多维度过程数据与 AI 模型输出，转化为运维人员可快速理解的监控界面——同时保证大屏、3D 设备资产与工程图在视觉与语义上的一致。
problem.en: Industrial predictive maintenance must turn multi-dimensional process data and AI model output into monitoring UIs operators can read quickly—while keeping dashboards, 3D equipment assets, and engineering drawings visually and semantically consistent.

approach.zh: 建立大屏组件规范与交付走查流程；并行制定 Keyshot 统一渲染标准、360° 交互序列与设备类型模板，让模型结果、设备认知与界面呈现使用同一套视觉语言。
approach.en: Built large-screen component specs and design-review delivery; in parallel, Keyshot rendering standards, 360° sequences, and equipment templates so model output, equipment recognition, and UI share one visual language.

impact.zh: 完成工业 AI 大屏组件体系与高保真交付
impact.en: Delivered industrial AI dashboard component system and hi-fi handoff

impact.zh: 建立 3D 泵组统一渲染与 SiePA 设备模板规范
impact.en: Established unified 3D pump-skid rendering and SiePA equipment templates

impact.zh: 支撑从被动维修到预测性维护的监控体验升级
impact.en: Supported UX upgrade from reactive repair to predictive maintenance

text.zh: 整合温度、压力、流量等生产过程信号，进行跨维度关联分析，从分散指标中识别设备异常模式与风险趋势。
text.en: Correlates temperature, pressure, flow, and other process signals across dimensions—surfacing anomaly patterns and risk trends from scattered plant metrics.

text.zh: 持续评估设备运行健康度，将模型输出转化为可读的监控视图，帮助运维人员快速判断当前状态与关注优先级。
text.en: Continuously assesses equipment health—translating model output into readable monitoring views so operators can judge status and priorities at a glance.

text.zh: 从故障后维修转向事前预警与计划性维护，降低非计划停机风险，提升产线连续性与维护效率。
text.en: Shifts from break-fix to early warning and planned maintenance—reducing unplanned downtime and improving line continuity and maintenance efficiency.

title.zh: 工业 AI 大屏交付

text.zh: 建立大屏组件规范与交付逻辑，从视觉风格到高保真原型一体走查，保障复杂 AI 监控界面的一致性与可落地性。
text.en: Established large-screen component specs and delivery logic—from visual language to hi-fi prototypes and design reviews—keeping complex AI monitoring UIs consistent and shippable.

text.zh: 以 Keyshot 建立泵组设备统一渲染标准，输出风格一致的高质量 3D 资产，支撑 SiePA 界面中的设备可视化呈现。
text.en: Keyshot-based unified rendering standards for pump skids—consistent, high-quality 3D assets that power equipment visualization across the SiePA UI.

text.zh: 制作 360° 交互浏览序列，沉淀 SiePA 设备类型模板与工程图视觉规范，让运维场景中的设备认知更直观、更统一。
text.en: 360° interactive viewing sequences plus SiePA equipment-type templates and engineering drawing standards—more intuitive, consistent equipment recognition in ops contexts.

summary.zh: SiePA 移动端工单运维与 Maintenance Copilot「小西」——移动场景信息架构与工业 AI 对话体验一体设计。
summary.en: SiePA mobile work-order ops and Maintenance Copilot—mobile IA and industrial AI conversation design in one program.

description.zh: SiePA 移动端面向现场工单运维场景，重构首页信息架构——聚焦当日维修任务、设备状态与备件批量管理，与 Web 大屏差异化定位、避免能力重复。同步设计 Maintenance Copilot「小西」IP 与工业 AI 对话界面，以符号化视觉语言适配 B 端审美，融入智能问答、故障诊断等运维工作流。
description.en: SiePA mobile targets field work-order operations—home IA redesigned around daily maintenance tasks, device status, and spare-parts batch management, clearly differentiated from the web dashboard. In parallel, designed Maintenance Copilot IP「Xiaoxi」and conversational UI with symbolic visual language for B2B contexts—integrated into smart Q&A, fault diagnosis, and ops workflows.

text.zh: 围绕现场运维动线重构首页结构，突出当日任务与设备状态，让移动端成为 Web 的补充而非重复。
text.en: Rebuilt mobile home IA around field ops flows—today's tasks and device status first, so mobile complements the web dashboard instead of duplicating it.

text.zh: 支持维修任务跟进、设备状态查看与备件批量管理，覆盖一线人员高频操作场景，提升现场响应效率。
text.en: Maintenance task tracking, device status views, and spare-parts batch management—covering high-frequency field workflows for faster on-site response.

text.zh: 打造 Maintenance Copilot「小西」工业 AI 角色 IP，建立可识别的品牌符号，增强智能助手在 B 端场景中的信任感与亲和力。
text.en: Built Maintenance Copilot「Xiaoxi」as a recognizable industrial AI character—brand symbols that add trust and approachability to the assistant in B2B contexts.

text.zh: 设计符号化对话界面与交互范式，适配工业审美与 AI 工作流，支撑智能问答、诊断引导等运维辅助能力的一致体验。
text.en: Symbolic conversational UI and interaction patterns aligned with industrial aesthetics and AI workflows—consistent experience for smart Q&A, diagnostic guidance, and ops assistance.

description.zh: UAL 硕士论文 Demo：MediaPipe 眼动追踪、Agent 知识库问答与 Web 集成验证。
description.en: UAL thesis demo—MediaPipe eye tracking, Agent Q&A knowledge base, web integration proof.
